Emma (AE): Hey team :wave: Need a quick playbook — HelixHealth is ready to sign the POC but procurement is requesting: PO + SOC2 Type II + a wet-ink signature on the Order Form. They're currently blocking kickoff.

Kai (Procurement): Do they explicitly refuse e-sign? sometimes a notarized scan will suffice. Also need the PO number to route invoices.

Emma (AE): PO is PO-88932. Legal already cleared the MSA/DPA with minor redlines, but they pushed back on Exhibit B (SLA) uptime credits — Jordan, can you confirm if we need to accept that redline?

Jordan (Legal): I looked at the redlines. SLA credit request is larger than usual but negotiable. If they insist on wet-ink only, propose we: (1) accept a wet-ink Order Form for their internal compliance, (2) countersign via DocuSign for our records, and (3) attach a short attestation clause allowing scanned copies for invoice processing. Example clause:

```
For avoidance of doubt, the Parties agree that a scanned copy or PDF of a manually executed Order Form shall have the same legal effect as an original wet-ink document for purposes of invoicing and contract formation.
```

If they still insist on original wet-ink for their audit, escalate to their security lead. I can live with the attestation and our countersignature pattern.

Natalie (Finance): If they mail an original wet-ink, we'll need the mailing address and a contact. Also note: if we receive a scanned/notarized copy only, Accounting needs a clear invoice remittance address and PO number to pay on Net30.

Emma (AE): Customer claims "Procurement Policy 12.4" mandates wet-ink for all vendors >$100k. For the POC it's under that threshold but their procurement compliance team is strict. They said they'd accept a notarized scanned copy as long as the original is on file.

Kai (Procurement): Ok — we can do the hybrid flow. I'll provide a shipping label and address. Please mail the original to:

HelixHealth Corp
Attn: Procurement – Contracts
PO Box 4128
Cambridge, MA 02139

Also confirm whether SOC2 link is OK (redacted), we usually provide a secure expiring link.

Emma (AE): SOC2 link (redacted) — https://secure.redwood.company/soc2/helix-2025-type2?token=REDACTED (expires in 30 days). I also uploaded the draft Order Form: https://secure.redwood.company/attachments/helix-poc-orderform-v2.pdf

Jordan (Legal): Perfect. Two extra asks: (a) add a line to the Order Form footer with the attestation language above, (b) add DPA reference: "Data processing is governed by the DPA attached as Exhibit C, incorporated by reference." I can draft a one-line addendum and attach it to the DocuSign envelope.

DocuSignBot: Envelope created (env_0a9f) for HelixHealth — recipients: HelixHealth Procurement, Emma (AE), Jordan (Legal). Status: created.

Kai (Procurement): We will accept a notarized scan as long as the original is mailed within 10 business days. Please include a cover letter with the PO number.

Natalie (Finance): Once we have a countersigned copy (DocuSign) or a notarized scan plus PO-88932, Finance will issue the invoice and process Net30. If customer wants Net45 it's a separate approval.

Emma (AE): I'll overnight the physical Order Form today and update with tracking. I'll also attach the notarized scan when they return it. Thanks all — I'll post updates here and ping @Jordan and @Natalie when the scan arrives. :thumbsup:
